content:
For \(t \leq 60\), revenue is at most \(60 \cdot 70 = 4200\), not greater than \(4200\).

For \(t > 60\), price is \(70 - (t-60) = 130 - t\), so revenue is
\[
R(t)=t(130-t).
\]
We need
\[
t(130-t)>4200.
\]
\[
130t-t^2>4200 \implies t^2-130t+4200<0.
\]
Factor:
\[
t^2-130t+4200=(t-60)(t-70).
\]
So
\[
(t-60)(t-70)<0,
\]
which holds for
\[
60<t<70.
\]
The largest integer \(t\) satisfying this is \(69\).

\[
\boxed{69}
\]
